mapper.select: SELECT employee.employee_id FROM employee employee JOIN employee_current_projection projection ON projection.employee_id = employee.employee_id JOIN employee_version version ON version.employee_version_id = projection.current_version_id WHERE version.employee_number = #{employeeNumber} LIMIT 1

SELECT employee.employee_id AS employeeId, version.employee_number AS employeeNumber, version.display_name AS displayName FROM employee employee JOIN employee_current_projection projection ON projection.employee_id = employee.employee_id JOIN employee_version version ON version.employee_version_id = projection.current_version_id
SELECT binding.binding_id FROM employee_source_binding binding WHERE binding.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND binding.effective_to IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT source.attendance_source_id FROM attendance_source source WHERE source.source_type = 'DELI_CLOUD' AND source.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY source.created_at, source.attendance_source_id LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(configuration.source_time_zone, 'Asia/Shanghai') FROM attendance_source_config_revision configuration WHERE configuration.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY configuration.revision_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(configuration.page_size, 500) FROM attendance_source_config_revision configuration WHERE configuration.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY configuration.revision_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT configuration.secret_reference_name FROM attendance_source_config_revision configuration WHERE configuration.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY configuration.revision_number DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_source_binding SET deli_user_id = #{deliUserId}, deli_ext_id = #{deliUserId}, deli_attendance_source_id = #{sourceId}, binding_status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmation_ref = #{confirmationRef}, deli_confirmed_by = #{actorId}, deli_confirmed_at = #{at}, deli_change_reason = #{reason}, effective_from = IF( effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from > #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveFrom}, effective_from), deli_row_version = deli_row_version + 1 WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId}
